verdict.rationale: Evidence mentions agent-related features like 'create tools for AI agents' and 'allow AI agents to deploy a project' (vercel-docs-4, vercel-docs-10), but neither explicitly describes an official MCP server exposing Vercel's platform to external agents — the capability described is closer to a toolkit for building agent tools, not a documented MCP server endpoint. missing for 10: explicit documentation of an official MCP server product/endpoint, setup instructions for connecting an agent via MCP, and any independent corroboration of it working.
